summary: HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal of 5.950% green senior unsecured notes due 2033 under an indenture dated June 24, 2026. The notes were issued in a private offering under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Proceeds will temporarily repay outstanding borrowings under credit facilities and be used for eligible green projects. The filing is a routine debt financing with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural terms were noted; the transaction is a conventional bond issuance of an existing public issuer.
